sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”（Casefile Presents）推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Or 7 Easy Street was a typical semi-detached terrace home for Melbourne's inner-city suburbs.
sentences.zh: 易街（Easy Street）7号是墨尔本内城区一栋典型的半独立式排屋。

sentences.en: Its front door opened to a narrow hallway, with three bedrooms leading off to the right.
sentences.zh: 前门通向一条狭窄的走廊，右侧有三间卧室。

sentences.en: A bathroom sat at the end of the hall, which also doubled as the laundry.
sentences.zh: 走廊尽头是一间浴室，同时也兼作洗衣房。

sentences.en: Another door led to a living room and modest kitchen, which opened to a small backyard encased by a fence.
sentences.zh: 另一扇门通往客厅和简易厨房，厨房外是一个被栅栏围起来的小后院。

sentences.en: From the yard, a gate granted access to a side laneway that separated number 147 from a neighbouring property and let out into the street.
sentences.zh: 从后院有一扇门可以通往侧巷，这条巷子将147号与邻居隔开，并通向街道。

sentences.en: On Thursday, January 13, 1977, next-door neighbour Janet waited anxiously in the laneway.
sentences.zh: 1977年1月13日，星期四，隔壁邻居珍妮特（Janet）焦急地在巷子里等待。

sentences.en: At her side was a German Shepherd Cross puppy named Mishka.
sentences.zh: 她身边是一只名叫米什卡（Mishka）的德国牧羊犬混种幼犬。

sentences.en: The dog belonged to the two young women who lived at 147 Easy Street, Suzanne Armstrong and Susan Bartlett.
sentences.zh: 这只狗属于住在易街147号的两位年轻女性：苏珊·阿姆斯特朗（Suzanne Armstrong）和苏珊·巴特利特（Susan Bartlett）。

sentences.en: Janet and her housemate Alona had found Mishka wandering the street two days earlier, but knocks and calls to 147 had gone unanswered.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特和她的室友阿洛娜（Alona）两天前在街上发现了流浪的米什卡，但她们敲门并呼喊147号却无人应答。

sentences.en: Janet and Alona had kept Mishka secured in their backyard, waiting for the two Su's to come looking for her.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特和阿洛娜把米什卡关在自家后院，等着那两位“苏”回来找狗。

sentences.en: But no one did.
sentences.zh: 但一直没人来。

sentences.en: At one stage, Alona peered over the fence into the backyard of 147 and noticed a rear door leading into the kitchen was open and a light was on.
sentences.zh: 有一次，阿洛娜越过栅栏看向147号的后院，发现通往厨房的后门开着，灯也亮着。

sentences.en: Her worries increased the following day, when she overheard the distressed sound of crying through the home's shared wall.
sentences.zh: 第二天，当她隔着两家共用的墙听到屋内传来痛苦的哭声时，她的担忧加剧了。

sentences.en: It was Suzanne's 16-month-old son.
sentences.zh: 那是苏珊16个月大的儿子。

sentences.en: It was unusual for his cries to go ignored, as Suzanne was a very attentive and affectionate mother.
sentences.zh: 他的哭声无人理会很不寻常，因为苏珊是一位非常细心且充满爱心的母亲。

sentences.en: At their wits' end, Alona and Janet headed next door to investigate.
sentences.zh: 束手无策之下，阿洛娜和珍妮特决定去隔壁一探究竟。

sentences.en: They bypassed the front door.
sentences.zh: 她们没有走前门。

sentences.en: A note they'd pinned there days earlier informing the women that their dog was loose remained untouched.
sentences.zh: 几天前她们贴在前门上告知对方狗走丢了的字条，依然原封不动。

sentences.en: Once in the side laneway, Janet waited with Mishka while Alona entered 147's backyard and disappeared through the open kitchen door.
sentences.zh: 进入侧巷后，珍妮特带着米什卡在原地等待，阿洛娜走进147号的后院，从敞开的厨房门消失了。

sentences.en: A short while later, Alona rushed from the house in a panic.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，阿洛娜惊慌失措地从屋里冲了出来。

sentences.en: Call the police, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“快报警。”

sentences.en: They're dead.
sentences.zh: “她们死了。”

sentences.en: It took two calls to 000 and over 20 minutes before a single police officer finally arrived at 147 Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 在拨打了两次000报警电话并等待了20多分钟后，一名警察终于抵达了易街147号。

sentences.en: A loner met him outside and led him into 147's backyard via the side laneway, along the same route she had taken almost half an hour earlier.
sentences.zh: 阿洛娜在外面迎接他，并经由侧巷带他进入147号的后院，走的正是她半小时前走过的那条路。

sentences.en: Mishka's vacant kennel sat under the kitchen window, near the open back door.
sentences.zh: 米什卡空荡荡的狗窝就在厨房窗下，靠近敞开的后门。

sentences.en: The officer stepped inside into the narrow kitchen with its bric-a-brac-filled shelves and onwards to the living room.
sentences.zh: 警察走进狭窄的厨房，穿过摆满杂物的架子，继续向客厅走去。

sentences.en: So far, nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，一切似乎都很正常。

sentences.en: There was a couch, television, and record player.
sentences.zh: 屋里有沙发、电视和唱片机。

sentences.en: Everything appeared neat and in order.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来整洁有序。

sentences.en: The officer reached the dimly lit hallway and peered towards the front door.
sentences.zh: 警察来到昏暗的走廊，向大门方向望去。

sentences.en: At the end of the hall, lying face down next to the door, was the bloodied body of Susan Bartlett.
sentences.zh: 在走廊尽头，门边趴着苏珊·巴特利特的血尸。

sentences.en: She was fully clothed in a nightdress, with numerous stab wounds to her arms, hands, legs, and upper torso.
sentences.zh: 她穿着睡衣，手臂、手部、腿部和上半身有多处刀伤。

sentences.en: Alongside her, the walls of the hallway were smeared and splattered with blood.
sentences.zh: 在她身旁，走廊的墙壁上沾满了喷溅的血迹。

sentences.en: Moving towards Susan's body, the officer glimpsed into the front bedroom.
sentences.zh: 走向苏珊的遗体时，警察瞥了一眼前面的卧室。

sentences.en: Inside, Suzanne Armstrong lay on the carpet.
sentences.zh: 里面，苏珊·阿姆斯特朗躺在地毯上。

sentences.en: She was naked, except for a red and white nightdress that had been pulled up around her head.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，只有一件红白相间的睡衣被推到了头顶。

sentences.en: Her arms, chest, and chin were riddled with knife wounds, and her legs were spread wide apart.
sentences.zh: 她的手臂、胸部和下巴布满了刀伤，双腿大张。

sentences.en: Grasping the enormity of the situation, the attending officer radioed for backup.
sentences.zh: 意识到事态严重，到场的警察立即用无线电呼叫支援。

sentences.en: A swarm of police cars then descended on Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 随后，大批警车涌向了易街。

sentences.en: The Bartlett family hadn't been too pleased when Susan announced that she was moving to Collingwood in October of 1976.
sentences.zh: 1976年10月，当苏珊·巴特利特宣布要搬到科林伍德（Collingwood）时，巴特利特一家并不太高兴。

sentences.en: Located four kilometres from Melbourne's CBD, the semi-industrial area had a chequered paSt.
sentences.zh: 这个半工业区距离墨尔本市中心四公里，有着一段复杂的过去。

sentences.en: Even though it was gaining popularity with students and young people looking to take advantage of the cheap rent, it still had a reputation as one of Victoria's roughest suburbs.
sentences.zh: 尽管它正受到学生和寻求廉价租金的年轻人的青睐，但它仍被认为是维多利亚州最混乱的郊区之一。

sentences.en: Crime rates were high, and drugs and gangs were an ongoing problem.
sentences.zh: 犯罪率很高，毒品和帮派问题一直存在。

sentences.en: But for 27-year-old Susan Bartlett, who went by Sue, Collingwood offered everything she needed.
sentences.zh: 但对于27岁的苏珊·巴特利特（大家都叫她苏）来说，科林伍德提供了她所需的一切。

sentences.en: There was a milk bar on the corner, reliable public transport nearby, and it wasn't far from the high school where she worked as an art teacher.
sentences.zh: 街角有一家小卖部，附近有可靠的公共交通，离她担任美术老师的中学也不远。

sentences.en: The house at 147 Easy Street was basic but cosy, and the rent was much more affordable than the place in nearby Richmond where she had been living previously.
sentences.zh: 易街147号的房子虽然简陋但很舒适，租金也比她之前住的附近的里士满（Richmond）要便宜得多。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Sue was looking forward to living with her friend, 28-year-old Suzanne Armstrong.
sentences.zh: 此外，苏很期待与她的朋友，28岁的苏珊·阿姆斯特朗住在一起。

sentences.en: The two knew one another from high school, having both grown up in the country town of Benalla.
sentences.zh: 两人从高中就认识了，都是在贝纳拉（Benalla）这个乡村小镇长大的。

sentences.en: The women had a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 她们有很多共同点。

sentences.en: Both were intelligent, creative and sociable, and they shared a love of cooking and travel.
sentences.zh: 她们都很聪明、有创造力且善于交际，并且都热爱烹饪和旅行。

sentences.en: They'd recently explored the Greek islands together, proving they could live alongside one another without issue.
sentences.zh: 她们最近还一起探索了希腊群岛，证明了她们可以毫无隔阂地共同生活。

sentences.en: Sue also had a great affection for Suzanne's toddler son, Gregory.
sentences.zh: 苏也非常疼爱苏珊蹒跚学步的儿子格雷戈里（Gregory）。

sentences.en: By January 1977, Sue and Suzanne had been living in Collingwood together for around two months.
sentences.zh: 到1977年1月，苏和苏珊已经在科林伍德合住了大约两个月。

sentences.en: Monday January 10 started normally for both women.
sentences.zh: 1月10日星期一，对两人来说都是平常的一天。

sentences.en: They rose early, ate breakfast together, and then went their separate ways.
sentences.zh: 她们早起，一起吃早餐，然后各奔东西。

sentences.en: Suzanne bathed Gregory, and the two took off on her bicycle to visit some friends.
sentences.zh: 苏珊给格雷戈里洗了澡，两人骑着自行车去拜访朋友。

sentences.en: Sue's mother was in town, and the two met to go shopping in the city.
sentences.zh: 苏的母亲当时在城里，两人见面去市区购物。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Sue went home to work on a dress she was in the process of sewing.
sentences.zh: 之后，苏回家继续缝制一件裙子。

sentences.en: She was a talented seamstress who made most of her own clothes, and she intended to wear this dress on a date she had planned for Wednesday night.
sentences.zh: 她是一位才华横溢的裁缝，大部分衣服都是自己做的，她打算在周三晚上的约会上穿这件裙子。

sentences.en: After working on the dress for a while, Sue began to cook dinner in preparation for company.
sentences.zh: 缝了一会儿裙子后，苏开始准备晚餐，以招待客人。

sentences.en: Sue's brother, Martin, was a regular visitor to 147 Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 苏的哥哥马丁（Martin）是易街147号的常客。

sentences.en: Having also made the move to the big city from Benalla, he enjoyed helping his sister with tasks around the house in exchange for a home-cooked meal.
sentences.zh: 他也从贝纳拉搬到了大城市，他喜欢帮妹妹做家务，换取一顿家常便饭。

sentences.en: Sue's stereo had recently broken, so Martin agreed to come over for dinner and then have a go at fixing it.
sentences.zh: 苏的音响最近坏了，所以马丁答应过来吃晚饭，顺便试着修好它。

sentences.en: Martin got the stereo working, and they all listened to some records, but then Sue and Suzanne said they wanted to watch television.
sentences.zh: 马丁修好了音响，大家一起听了些唱片，但随后苏和苏珊说她们想看电视。

sentences.en: One of their favourite shows, The Sullivans, was about to start, and they were keen to see it once Suzanne put her son down for the night.
sentences.zh: 她们最喜欢的节目之一《沙利文一家》（The Sullivans）即将开播，她们想等苏珊哄儿子睡下后观看。

sentences.en: At around 9pm, Martin bid the women farewell, with the Bartlett siblings making plans to catch up again the following week.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点左右，马丁向她们告别，巴特利特兄妹约定下周再聚。

sentences.en: It was an enjoyable, albeit uneventful evening.
sentences.zh: 那是一个愉快但平淡的夜晚。

sentences.en: Everyone was in good spirits, and nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 每个人心情都很好，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: When Martin left, Suzanne and Sue were comfortably settled in front of the television.
sentences.zh: 马丁离开时，苏珊和苏正舒适地坐在电视机前。

sentences.en: He would become the last person to see his sister and her friend alive.
sentences.zh: 他成了最后见到妹妹及其朋友活着的人。

sentences.en: Given there were no further sightings of either of the women after Martin left, and their dog was found wandering the streets the following day,
sentences.zh: 鉴于马丁离开后就再没有人见过这两位女性，且她们的狗在第二天被发现流浪街头，

sentences.en: it was determined they had likely been killed sometime in the early hours of Tuesday January 11.
sentences.zh: 据推断，她们很可能是在1月11日星期二的凌晨遇害的。

sentences.en: Neighbours didn't hear or see anything out of the ordinary, although next-door neighbour Alona recalled hearing Gregory crying for a prolonged period on Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 邻居们没有听到或看到任何异常，尽管隔壁邻居阿洛娜回忆说，周二早上听到格雷戈里长时间地哭泣。

sentences.en: This meant that the bodies of Susan Bartlett and Suzanne Armstrong lay undiscovered in their home for three days, while the young boy lay distressed and alone in his cot.
sentences.zh: 这意味着苏珊·巴特利特和苏珊·阿姆斯特朗的遗体在屋内躺了三天无人发现，而那个小男孩则独自在婴儿床里受尽折磨。

sentences.en: Collectively, the young women had been stabbed a total of 82 times, with Sue sustaining 55 stab wounds to Suzanne's 27.
sentences.zh: 这两位年轻女性总共被刺了82刀，其中苏身上有55处刀伤，苏珊有27处。

sentences.en: The wounds were deep, having likely been inflicted using forceful rapid thrusts with a 2.5cm wide blade.
sentences.zh: 伤口很深，很可能是用2.5厘米宽的刀刃强力快速刺入造成的。

sentences.en: Suzanne had also been raped post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 苏珊在死后还遭到了强奸。

sentences.en: However, it didn't appear that any great struggle had taken place.
sentences.zh: 然而，现场似乎并没有发生激烈的搏斗。

sentences.en: Other than a vase of flowers that had been knocked over,
sentences.zh: 除了一个被撞翻的花瓶外，

sentences.en: Suzanne's bedroom was in relatively neat order.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的卧室相对整洁。

sentences.en: Blood had pooled on the carpet above her head, several drops of blood stained her bed sheet, and a pair of her underwear lay beside her.
sentences.zh: 她头部的地毯上有血迹，床单上有几滴血，旁边放着她的内衣。

sentences.en: The scene indicated that Suzanne had been reading in bed when she got up and encountered her killer, who then launched a brutal and frenzied attack.
sentences.zh: 现场迹象表明，苏珊当时正在床上看书，起身时遇到了凶手，随后遭到了残忍而疯狂的袭击。

sentences.en: There were also smears of blood on the lamp and alarm clock next to the bed.
sentences.zh: 床边的台灯和闹钟上也有血迹。

sentences.en: Either Suzanne had reached over in an attempt to grab her bedside phone to call for help, or the killer had reached over to turn the lamp off.
sentences.zh: 要么是苏珊伸手想拿床边的电话求救，要么是凶手伸手关掉了台灯。

sentences.en: The location of Sue Bartlett's body in the hallway, just outside of Suzanne's bedroom, suggested she had likely confronted the killer after Suzanne was already dead.
sentences.zh: 苏·巴特利特的遗体位于走廊上，就在苏珊卧室外，这表明她很可能是在苏珊遇害后与凶手对峙的。

sentences.en: Sue's hands and arms were covered with defence wounds, which explained the smears of blood on the hallway walls.
sentences.zh: 苏的手和手臂上布满了防御性伤口，这解释了走廊墙壁上的血迹。

sentences.en: Investigators believed that after killing Sue, the perpetrator returned to Suzanne's bedroom to rape her lifeless body.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，在杀害苏之后，凶手又回到苏珊的卧室强奸了她冰冷的遗体。

sentences.en: The attack had been so quick and savage that neither woman had any time or opportunity to seek help.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生得太快太凶残，以至于两人都没有时间和机会寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Gregory was discovered in the middle room between the two women's bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里是在两人卧室中间的房间里被发现的。

sentences.en: He was found lying hungry in his cot, his skin pale and nappy-soiled.
sentences.zh: 他被发现时正饿着肚子躺在婴儿床里，皮肤苍白，尿布脏了。

sentences.en: Other than having been dehydrated and distressed for some time, he was alive and unhurt.
sentences.zh: 除了因脱水和受惊了一段时间外，他活着且没有受伤。

sentences.en: His room, which doubled as Sue's sewing room, was relatively tidy and didn't appear to have been touched during the attack.
sentences.zh: 他的房间兼作苏的缝纫室，相对整洁，袭击过程中似乎没有被触动。

sentences.en: Sue's bedroom at the end of the hall was similarly neat, and there was no blood.
sentences.zh: 走廊尽头苏的卧室同样整洁，没有血迹。

sentences.en: Smudges of blood were discovered in the bathroom, specifically in the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 浴室里发现了血迹，特别是在浴缸里。

sentences.en: Blood pooled around the plug hole and small bone splinters were found in the crook of the drain.
sentences.zh: 下水口周围有血迹，排水管弯头处发现了细小的骨头碎片。

sentences.en: This suggested that the killer had showered after carrying out the murders, with the bone fragments having likely been washed from their knife.
sentences.zh: 这表明凶手在行凶后洗了澡，骨头碎片很可能是从刀上冲洗下来的。

sentences.en: The knife itself was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 凶器本身下落不明。

sentences.en: Small spots of blood were also found on the lid of the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 洗衣机盖上也发现了小血点。

sentences.en: The killer might have used the machine, or at least considered doing so.
sentences.zh: 凶手可能使用了洗衣机，或者至少考虑过使用它。

sentences.en: The living room revealed further evidence of the killer's attempt to clean themselves up.
sentences.zh: 客厅里发现了凶手试图清理现场的进一步证据。

sentences.en: A small blood-soaked towel lay on the couch.
sentences.zh: 沙发上放着一条浸满血迹的小毛巾。

sentences.en: A second blood-soaked towel was found at a playground 300 metres from number 147, on Wellington Street.
sentences.zh: 第二条浸满血迹的毛巾在距离147号300米外的惠灵顿街（Wellington Street）的一个游乐场被发现。

sentences.en: As DNA testing wasn't available in the late 70s, it couldn't be determined whether any of the blood belonged to the killer.
sentences.zh: 由于70年代末还没有DNA检测技术，无法确定这些血迹是否属于凶手。

sentences.en: Sue's blood type was Type O, and Suzanne's was Type A, both common blood groups.
sentences.zh: 苏的血型是O型，苏珊的是A型，都是常见的血型。

sentences.en: Only Type A blood was found in Suzanne's bedroom, the bathroom, and on the blood-soaked towels, while only Type O blood was found smeared in the hallway.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的卧室、浴室和浸血毛巾上只发现了A型血，而走廊上只发现了O型血迹。

sentences.en: This either meant that the killer wasn't wounded during the attacks, or that he shared a common blood type with one of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要么凶手在袭击中没有受伤，要么他与其中一名受害者血型相同。

sentences.en: However, he did leave one undisputable piece of evidence behind.
sentences.zh: 然而，他确实留下了一个无可辩驳的证据。

sentences.en: Semen was found on Suzanne Armstrong's body, as well as on her bedroom carpet, bed sheets, and one of the towels.
sentences.zh: 在苏珊·阿姆斯特朗的遗体上，以及她的卧室地毯、床单和其中一条毛巾上都发现了精液。

sentences.en: There were no signs of forced entry into number 147, and when police arrived, both the front and back doors were unlocked.
sentences.zh: 147号没有强行闯入的迹象，警察到达时，前后门都没有锁。

sentences.en: If the women had purposely left the doors unlocked, which they were known to do, the killer might have let himself in uninvited,
sentences.zh: 如果这两位女性是有意不锁门（她们确实有这个习惯），那么凶手可能是未经邀请就进来了，

sentences.en: walked into Suzanne Armstrong's bedroom, and launched an attack.
sentences.zh: 走进苏珊·阿姆斯特朗的卧室，并发动了袭击。

sentences.en: Yet, the top sheet of Suzanne's bed was neatly folded over, and a book was face down on the corner.
sentences.zh: 然而，苏珊床上的床单折叠得很整齐，角落里还扣着一本书。

sentences.en: It appeared as though she'd been reading in bed when her killer entered.
sentences.zh: 看起来她当时正在床上看书，凶手就进来了。

sentences.en: If it was a stranger, Suzanne would have scrambled out of bed in a panic, leaving things in a far more disorderly state than the way they were found.
sentences.zh: 如果是陌生人，苏珊会惊慌失措地从床上爬起来，现场会比现在混乱得多。

sentences.en: Maybe the killer had knocked on the front door, or on Suzanne's window, and she had let him inside.
sentences.zh: 也许凶手敲了前门或苏珊的窗户，然后她让他进来了。

sentences.en: Or perhaps she had been expecting a guest, and had left the front or back door unlocked so they could let themselves in.
sentences.zh: 又或者她当时在等客人，所以没锁前后门，好让对方自己进来。

sentences.en: They might have exchanged words, or maybe Suzanne rejected his sexual advances, which had enraged him.
sentences.zh: 他们可能发生了争执，或者苏珊拒绝了他的性要求，这激怒了他。

sentences.en: Suzanne's family didn't believe she was expecting a visitor.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的家人不相信她在等客人。

sentences.en: Suzanne always wore decorative earrings, but at the time of her death, she was wearing plain gold sleepers.
sentences.zh: 苏珊总是戴着装饰性耳环，但她去世时戴的是普通的金圈耳环。

sentences.en: Her family said she would never wear sleepers if she was expecting male company.
sentences.zh: 她的家人说，如果她要见男性客人，绝不会戴这种圈耳环。

sentences.en: Sue was likely in the backyard, kitchen, or possibly doing some laundry at the time, which would explain why she hadn't heard the attack right away.
sentences.zh: 苏当时可能在后院、厨房，或者正在洗衣服，这解释了为什么她没有第一时间听到袭击声。

sentences.en: When she realised what was going on, she likely confronted the assailant, who turned his fury to her.
sentences.zh: 当她意识到发生了什么时，很可能与袭击者发生了对峙，袭击者随后将怒火转向了她。

sentences.en: Sue had been stabbed almost twice as many times as Suzanne.
sentences.zh: 苏被刺的次数几乎是苏珊的两倍。

sentences.en: There were wounds all over her body, including on her buttocks and the back of her thighs.
sentences.zh: 她全身布满伤口，包括臀部和大腿后侧。

sentences.en: The killer had continued his attack, even after Sue lay incapacitated and face down on the floor.
sentences.zh: 即使苏已经倒地失去反抗能力，凶手仍继续行凶。

sentences.en: However, the level of overkill Sue endured didn't necessarily mean that she was the killer's main target.
sentences.zh: 然而，苏所遭受的过度伤害并不一定意味着她是凶手的主要目标。

sentences.en: The fact that Sue hadn't been sexually assaulted, whereas Suzanne had, indicated that Suzanne was most likely the intended victim.
sentences.zh: 苏没有遭到性侵，而苏珊遭到了，这表明苏珊很可能是预定的受害者。

sentences.en: Sue might have been killed in such a vicious way because she took the perpetrator by surprise and he wanted to ensure there were no witnesses.
sentences.zh: 苏之所以被如此残忍地杀害，可能是因为她让袭击者措手不及，而他想确保没有目击者。

sentences.en: The question remained, who would want to hurt these two young women?
sentences.zh: 问题依然存在：谁会想伤害这两位年轻女性？

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: When investigators initially examined Sue Bartlett's bedroom, nothing appeared noticeably out of place.
sentences.zh: 调查人员最初检查苏·巴特利特的卧室时，没有发现任何明显异常。

sentences.en: However, upon closer inspection, they realised something wasn't quite right.
sentences.zh: 然而，经过仔细检查，他们意识到有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Sue's bed sat directly under a window, which looked out to the side laneway.
sentences.zh: 苏的床正对着一扇窗户，窗外是侧巷。

sentences.en: The blind on the window had fallen away at the corner and underneath was a dirty shoe print on Sue's bedspread.
sentences.zh: 窗帘的角落掉落了，下面苏的床罩上有一个脏兮兮的鞋印。

sentences.en: After news of the murders hit the press, a tobacco salesman named Colin Fowler, not his real name, showed up at the police station claiming he was the one who left the shoe print.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案的消息见报后，一名叫科林·福勒（Colin Fowler，化名）的烟草推销员来到警察局，声称那个鞋印是他留下的。

sentences.en: Colin explained that on Tuesday, January 11, he was growing worried about the fact he hadn't heard from Sue in a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 科林解释说，1月11日星期二，他因为两天没收到苏的消息而感到担忧。

sentences.en: The two had met the previous week and had a date planned for Wednesday evening.
sentences.zh: 两人上周见过面，并计划在周三晚上约会。

sentences.en: Colin had been trying to call Sue to confirm the details, but nobody was answering the phone.
sentences.zh: 科林一直在给苏打电话确认细节，但没人接听。

sentences.en: He wondered if she might have given him the wrong number by mistake.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑是不是苏不小心给了他错误的号码。

sentences.en: Colin liked Sue and was eager for their date to go ahead.
sentences.zh: 科林喜欢苏，非常期待他们的约会。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, he had a few too many drinks and decided to stop by Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，他喝多了，决定去易街看看。

sentences.en: Colin was familiar with the house, having spent the night there.
sentences.zh: 科林对这所房子很熟悉，因为他曾在那儿过夜。

sentences.en: He headed down the side laneway and knocked on Sue's bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 他沿着侧巷走过去，敲了苏的卧室窗户。

sentences.en: There was no reply.
sentences.zh: 没有人回应。

sentences.en: Not thinking straight on account of being inebriated,
sentences.zh: 因为喝醉了，脑子不太清醒，

sentences.en: Colin decided to climb in through the window and check Sue's phone to make sure he had been calling the right number.
sentences.zh: 科林决定从窗户爬进去，查看苏的手机，确认自己拨打的号码是否正确。

sentences.en: As he clambered through, he knocked the window blind off in the process before leaving his dirty shoe print on Sue's bed.
sentences.zh: 他爬进去的时候，顺手把窗帘撞掉了，还在苏的床上留下了脏鞋印。

sentences.en: Colin crept up the dark hallway and into the living room.
sentences.zh: 科林蹑手蹑脚地穿过昏暗的走廊，进入了客厅。

sentences.en: The light was on in the kitchen, so he managed to find the phone, which had its number displayed on the dial.
sentences.zh: 厨房里亮着灯，他成功找到了电话，拨号盘上显示着号码。

sentences.en: It confirmed that he'd been calling the right number.
sentences.zh: 这证实了他确实拨打的是正确的号码。

sentences.en: So where was Sue?
sentences.zh: 那么苏去哪儿了呢？

sentences.en: Colin didn't poke around any further.
sentences.zh: 科林没有再四处查看。

sentences.en: He was keen to get in and out as quickly as possible, so he hastily left the house the same way he'd entered.
sentences.zh: 他急于尽快离开，于是匆忙原路返回，离开了房子。

sentences.en: Had he looked down the hallway, he would have noticed Sue's bloodied body lying by the front door.
sentences.zh: 如果他当时往走廊里看一眼，就会发现苏血肉模糊的尸体正躺在前门边。

sentences.en: Whether it was the fold of the alcohol or the darkness,
sentences.zh: 不管是酒精的作用还是因为黑暗，

sentences.en: Colin claimed he never saw Sue's body.
sentences.zh: 科林坚称他从未看到苏的尸体。

sentences.en: Colin found out about the murders after a friend read about them in a newspaper and recognised Sue's photo.
sentences.zh: 科林是在一位朋友从报纸上读到谋杀案并认出苏的照片后，才得知此事的。

sentences.en: He was horrified to discover he'd been in the house while the two women lay undiscovered.
sentences.zh: 他惊恐地发现，在那两名女性遇害后无人发现期间，他竟然就在那栋房子里。

sentences.en: He also realised this didn't look good for him.
sentences.zh: 他也意识到这对自己的处境非常不利。

sentences.en: Enlisting the help of a lawyer,
sentences.zh: 在律师的帮助下，

sentences.en: Colin immediately went to the police station to clear his name.
sentences.zh: 科林立即前往警察局以洗清自己的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Investigators weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 调查人员并不买账。

sentences.en: It seemed highly unlikely that Colin could have stood mere metres away from Sue's body and not seen her, nor heard Suzanne's son's weak cries for attention.
sentences.zh: 科林站在离苏的尸体仅几米远的地方却没看见她，也没听到苏珊儿子的微弱哭声，这看起来极不可能。

sentences.en: Colin had also been one of the last people to spend time at 147 Easy Street, having slept over with Sue two nights prior.
sentences.zh: 科林也是最后几个在易街147号待过的人之一，两天前他还在苏那里过夜。

sentences.en: Witnesses recalled seeing his car parked out the front at the time.
sentences.zh: 目击者回忆说，当时看到他的车停在前面。

sentences.en: It was a white Mercedes and hard to miss.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆白色的奔驰，很难让人忽略。

sentences.en: Was it possible that Colin had sneaked in through the window, killed both women, washed himself clean, then quickly fled the area?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能科林是从窗户潜入，杀害了两名女性，清洗干净后迅速逃离了现场？

sentences.en: His story about checking Sue's phone number could be a ruse used to explain away his footprint at the scene.
sentences.zh: 他关于查看苏的电话号码的说法，可能只是为了解释他在现场留下的脚印而编造的借口。

sentences.en: According to Colin, a friend had accompanied him on his late night trek to Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 据科林说，他深夜前往易街时，有一位朋友陪同。

sentences.en: He stood watch in the laneway as Colin broke into Sue's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当科林闯入苏的卧室时，那个人在巷子里放哨。

sentences.en: The friend vouched for Colin's entire story, confirming he was in and out of the house in a matter of minutes and made no mention of seeing anything out of the ordinary inside.
sentences.zh: 那位朋友为科林的全部陈述作了担保，证实他几分钟内就进出了房子，并且提到在里面没有看到任何异常情况。

sentences.en: Yet, Colin Fowler wasn't the only person prowling around 147 Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 然而，科林·福勒并不是唯一一个在易街147号附近徘徊的人。

sentences.en: In the kitchen, investigators discovered an envelope tucked under an ashtray on a table.
sentences.zh: 在厨房里，调查人员在桌上的烟灰缸下发现了一个信封。

sentences.en: A phone number was written on the back of it along with the message to ring now.
sentences.zh: 信封背面写着一个电话号码，还有一条留言，写着“现在打”。

sentences.en: It was an urgent request as the word now was capitalised and had been followed up with an exclamation mark.
sentences.zh: 这是一个紧急请求，因为“现在”这个词是大写的，后面还跟着一个感叹号。

sentences.en: Alongside the phone number was the name
sentences.zh: 电话号码旁边写着名字：

sentences.en: Barry Woodard.
sentences.zh: 巴里·伍达德。

sentences.en: 31-year-old Barry Woodard was thrilled when he was set up on a blind date with Suzanne Armstrong late in 1976.
sentences.zh: 31岁的巴里·伍达德在1976年底被安排与苏珊·阿姆斯特朗相亲时，感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: They were introduced by Suzanne's sister who was going out with Barry's brother.
sentences.zh: 他们是由苏珊的妹妹介绍认识的，她当时正在和巴里的弟弟交往。

sentences.en: Barry and Suzanne got along great.
sentences.zh: 巴里和苏珊相处得很好。

sentences.en: Although they had only been on three dates,
sentences.zh: 虽然他们只约会了三次，

sentences.en: Barry could feel himself falling for Suzanne and he even began considering marriage.
sentences.zh: 巴里已经感觉到自己爱上了苏珊，甚至开始考虑结婚。

sentences.en: On Sunday, January 9, 1977,
sentences.zh: 1977年1月9日，星期日，

sentences.en: Suzanne joined Barry for dinner at his sister's house in the suburb of Northcote where Barry was staying at the time.
sentences.zh: 苏珊陪巴里在他妹妹位于诺斯科特郊区的家中吃了晚饭，巴里当时住在那里。

sentences.en: He worked as a roving shearer which meant he was constantly moving around but he typically stayed at his sister's house on weekends.
sentences.zh: 他是一名流动剪羊毛工，这意味着他经常四处奔波，但周末通常住在妹妹家。

sentences.en: After dinner, he dropped Suzanne back at Easy Street.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，他开车把苏珊送回了易街。

sentences.en: Barry was invited inside for coffee and Suzanne suggested he stay the night but as he was expecting a call regarding a shearing job early in the morning,
sentences.zh: 巴里被邀请进去喝咖啡，苏珊建议他留宿，但因为他第二天一早要等一个关于剪羊毛工作的电话，

sentences.en: Barry declined the offer.
sentences.zh: 巴里婉拒了。

sentences.en: He drove back to Northcote at around midnight.
sentences.zh: 他在午夜左右开车回到了诺斯科特。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: Barry didn't get the job call he was expecting.
sentences.zh: 巴里没有接到他预期的工作电话。

sentences.en: He called Suzanne to let her know that he wouldn't be working after all but nobody answered the phone.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给苏珊，告诉她他最终没能去工作，但没人接电话。

sentences.en: The two had already discussed another dinner date for Tuesday evening and Barry was keen to lock in the details.
sentences.zh: 两人已经商定周二晚上再约一次晚餐，巴里很想敲定细节。

sentences.en: He kept calling Suzanne but the phone continued to ring out.
sentences.zh: 他不停地给苏珊打电话，但电话一直无人接听。

sentences.en: By Tuesday evening, he still hadn't heard from Suzanne to confirm what time she wanted to be picked up that night.
sentences.zh: 到了周二晚上，他仍然没有收到苏珊的消息来确认那天晚上几点去接她。

sentences.en: Barry tried calling her several more times but with no success.
sentences.zh: 巴里又试着打了好几次电话，但都没有成功。

sentences.en: By Wednesday afternoon,
sentences.zh: 到了周三下午，

sentences.en: Barry was really starting to worry.
sentences.zh: 巴里开始真正担心起来。

sentences.en: Although he hadn't known Suzanne long, it simply wasn't like her to flake on their plans without being in touch.
sentences.zh: 虽然他认识苏珊不久，但她绝不是那种不打招呼就爽约的人。

sentences.en: He shared his concerns with his brother and the two decided to drop by Easy Street to make sure everything was okay.
sentences.zh: 他向弟弟表达了自己的担忧，两人决定顺路去易街看看，确保一切安好。

sentences.en: They arrived at around 8.30pm on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 他们于周三晚上8点30分左右到达。

sentences.en: It didn't look like anyone was home.
sentences.zh: 看起来家里没人。

sentences.en: No lights were on inside and there was a note pinned to the front door.
sentences.zh: 屋里没开灯，前门上还别着一张字条。

sentences.en: The two brothers walked down the side laneway and threw the rear gate into the back yard.
sentences.zh: 两兄弟沿着侧巷走，推开后门进入后院。

sentences.en: A light was on in the kitchen and the back door was slightly ajar.
sentences.zh: 厨房里亮着灯，后门虚掩着。

sentences.en: Barry knocked on the door and yelled out
sentences.zh: 巴里敲了敲门，大声喊着

sentences.en: Suzanne's name.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的名字。

sentences.en: There was no reply.
sentences.zh: 没有人回应。

sentences.en: He figured she couldn't be too far away but the thought of entering the house without permission made Barry feel uneasy.
sentences.zh: 他想她应该不会走太远，但未经允许进入房子的想法让巴里感到不安。

sentences.en: The brothers decided they'd just duck inside quickly to leave
sentences.zh: 两兄弟决定进去快速留给

sentences.en: Suzanne a note.
sentences.zh: 苏珊一张字条。

sentences.en: They went into the kitchen, scribbled Barry's number down on the back of an envelope and left it on the table.
sentences.zh: 他们走进厨房，在信封背面潦草地写下巴里的号码，然后放在桌子上。

sentences.en: Barry's brother suggested they check the bedrooms but Barry didn't feel comfortable going any further so they left via the back door and returned to their sister's house.
sentences.zh: 巴里的弟弟建议去卧室看看，但巴里觉得再往里走不太合适，于是他们从后门离开，回到了妹妹家。

sentences.en: Had they headed down the hallway they would have encountered the dead bodies of both women.
sentences.zh: 如果他们当时往走廊里走，就会撞见两名女性的尸体。

sentences.en: On Thursday morning
sentences.zh: 周四早上，

sentences.en: Barry called
sentences.zh: 巴里再次拨打了

sentences.en: 147 Easy Street again.
sentences.zh: 易街147号的电话。

sentences.en: Finally someone picked up the phone.
sentences.zh: 终于有人接听了。

sentences.en: It was a homicide detective who broke the news about the murders.
sentences.zh: 那是一名凶杀案侦探，他告知了谋杀案的消息。

sentences.en: Barry was in shock.
sentences.zh: 巴里震惊了。

sentences.en: When he identified himself the detective recognised his name from the envelope on the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 当他报出自己的名字时，侦探认出了厨房桌上那个信封上的名字。

sentences.en: He immediately sent authorities to Barry's sister's house to bring him to the police station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 他立即派人前往巴里妹妹家，将他带到警察局接受审讯。

sentences.en: Barry insisted he had nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 巴里坚称自己没有什么可隐瞒的。

sentences.en: He hadn't noticed anything unusual at 147 Easy Street when he visited on Wednesday night nor had he heard
sentences.zh: 他周三晚上去的时候，并没有注意到易街147号有什么异常，也没有听到

sentences.en: Gregory crying.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里的哭声。

sentences.en: Barry said that if he had he would have gone down the hallway to see if everything was alright.
sentences.zh: 巴里说，如果听到了，他一定会沿着走廊去看看是否一切正常。

sentences.en: As for the night of the murders
sentences.zh: 至于谋杀案发生的当晚，

sentences.en: Barry told police he and his brother went drinking at a pub before returning to their sister's home where they were both staying.
sentences.zh: 巴里告诉警察，他和弟弟去酒吧喝酒，然后回到了他们暂住的妹妹家。

sentences.en: They ate a late dinner, had some more drinks and watched television.
sentences.zh: 他们吃了顿晚饭，又喝了点酒，看了看电视。

sentences.en: Barry said he went to bed around midnight and didn't get up until early the next morning.
sentences.zh: 巴里说他午夜左右就上床睡觉了，直到第二天一早才起床。

sentences.en: His sister verified this alibi.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹证实了这个不在场证明。

sentences.en: She had stayed up until 2am and didn't recall seeing
sentences.zh: 她一直熬到凌晨2点，不记得看到

sentences.en: Barry leave the house at any point.
sentences.zh: 巴里在任何时候离开过房子。

sentences.en: When she got up at 6.30am she brought
sentences.zh: 当她早上6点30分起床时，她给

sentences.en: Barry a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 巴里端了一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: There was nothing unusual about his appearance or demeanour.
sentences.zh: 他的外表和举止没有任何异常。

sentences.en: Barry was heartbroken by the news of Suzanne's death.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的死讯让巴里心碎不已。

sentences.en: He declared his love for her via the press, saying he was very fond of Suzanne's son and would happily adopt him.
sentences.zh: 他通过媒体表达了对她的爱，说他非常喜欢苏珊的儿子，并愿意收养他。

sentences.zh: 如果当地警方参与其中，他们对该地区的专业知识可能会引出更多潜在的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: It didn't help that days had already passed before the crime scene was discovered.
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场被发现之前已经过去了几天，这无济于事。

sentences.en: This gave the perpetrator plenty of time to dispose of evidence or flee Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 这给了肇事者充足的时间来处理证据或逃离墨尔本。

sentences.en: Secondly, although the crime scene was secured as soon as officers descended on the property, things were done differently in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 其次，尽管警察一到达现场就封锁了犯罪现场，但70年代的做法与现在不同。

sentences.en: Police were free to move through the crime scene without wearing any protective clothing.
sentences.zh: 警察可以随意在犯罪现场走动，而无需穿戴任何防护服。

sentences.en: One officer had even washed his hands in the bathroom sink.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一名警官在浴室的水槽里洗了手。

sentences.en: Failure to maintain the integrity of the crime scene meant crucial evidence might have been missed.
sentences.zh: 未能保持犯罪现场的完整性意味着关键证据可能已被遗漏。

sentences.en: Complicating matters further was the fact that several detectives seemed convinced they already had their killer within sights.
sentences.zh: 更复杂的是，几名侦探似乎确信他们已经锁定了杀手。

sentences.en: Many believed that John Grant's connection was too coincidental, and it would be a matter of time before evidence linked him to the crime.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为约翰·格兰特的关联太过巧合，证据迟早会把他与犯罪联系起来。

sentences.en: Others had the same feelings about Barry Woodard, the man Suzanne was dating at the time of her death.
sentences.zh: 其他人对巴里·伍达德也有同样的感觉，他是苏珊去世时正在交往的男人。

sentences.en: This tunnel vision meant that other persons of interest were potentially overlooked.
sentences.zh: 这种“隧道视野”意味着其他潜在嫌疑人可能被忽视了。

sentences.en: During the short amount of time that Sue Bartlett and Suzanne Armstrong were living on Easy Street, major construction was taking place in the area.
sentences.zh: 在苏·巴特莱特和苏珊·阿姆斯特朗住在易街的短时间内，该地区正在进行大规模施工。

sentences.en: Not only was nearby Hoddle Street being widened in conjunction with the new freeway, but a new community health centre was being built right behind the women's home.
sentences.zh: 不仅附近的霍德尔街正在扩建以配合新的高速公路，一个新的社区卫生中心也正在她们家后面建设。

sentences.en: Construction workers and other tradies were in and out of the site constantly.
sentences.zh: 建筑工人和承包商不断进出工地。

sentences.en: Was it possible that one of them had glimpsed into the backyard of 147 Easy Street and caught sight of Sue or Suzanne lounging in their backyard?
sentences.zh: 有没有可能其中一人瞥见了易街147号的后院，看到了苏或苏珊在后院休息？

sentences.en: Perhaps they'd taken an unhealthy interest in one or both of the women and returned to the property after dark.
sentences.zh: 也许他们对其中一人或两人产生了不健康的兴趣，并在天黑后回到了该处。

sentences.en: Similarly, concreting work had only recently been done outside of number 147.
sentences.zh: 同样，147号门外的混凝土工程也是最近才完成的。

sentences.en: Could one of these workers have peered in through the front window, taken note of Suzanne and returned to approach her at the property later?
sentences.zh: 会不会是这些工人中的一人透过前窗往里看，注意到了苏珊，随后又回到该处接近她？

sentences.en: Many of these workers were employed short-term and moved around often, so with police chasing other avenues in the early days of the investigation,
sentences.zh: 这些工人大多是短期受雇，经常变动，因此在调查初期警方追查其他线索时，

sentences.en: it would have been easy for any of them to fall through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 他们中的任何一个人都很容易成为漏网之鱼。

sentences.en: On top of the lacklustre investigation, the Armstrong and Bartlett families weren't happy with how they were treated by the authorities.
sentences.zh: 除了调查不力之外，阿姆斯特朗和巴特莱特家族对当局对待他们的方式也不满意。

sentences.en: They were constantly chasing updates themselves rather than being kept in the loop with how things were progressing.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不自己不断追问最新进展，而不是被告知案件的进展情况。

sentences.en: Suzanne's family was never even interviewed by police.
sentences.zh: 苏珊的家人甚至从未接受过警方的采访。

sentences.en: They had to make their own appointment to go down to the station and provide information.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不自己预约去警察局提供信息。

sentences.en: By July, six months had passed and police were no closer to making an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 到了7月，六个月过去了，警方在逮捕嫌疑人方面毫无进展。

sentences.en: An inquest into the murders was held at the Melbourne Coroner's Court, but no new evidence was presented.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本验尸官法庭对这起谋杀案进行了调查，但没有提出任何新证据。

sentences.en: The coroner concluded that Suzanne Armstrong and Susan Bartlett had been brutally killed by an unknown person or persons and shed no light on who that person might be.
sentences.zh: 验尸官得出的结论是，苏珊·阿姆斯特朗和苏珊·巴特莱特被不明身份的人残忍杀害，但没有说明此人可能是谁。

sentences.en: Suzanne's sister, Gail, was given custody of young Gregory
sentences.zh: 苏珊的姐姐盖尔获得了小格雷戈里的监护权。

sentences.en: This was a standard payment of up to $5,000 issued by the Victorian Crimes Compensation Tribunal for dependents of victims who were injured or murdered in a crime.
sentences.zh: 这是维多利亚州犯罪赔偿法庭为在犯罪中受伤或被谋杀的受害者的家属发放的最高5000美元的标准赔偿金。

sentences.en: In another blow to the Armstrong family, the tribunal rejected the application on the basis that Gregory was legally considered an illegitimate child
sentences.zh: 对阿姆斯特朗家族的另一个打击是，法庭以格雷戈里在法律上被视为非婚生子女为由拒绝了申请，

sentences.en: because Suzanne hadn't been married to his father.
sentences.zh: 因为苏珊没有与他的父亲结婚。

sentences.en: When word spread about the rejection, the people of Australia were outraged.
sentences.zh: 当拒绝赔偿的消息传开后，澳大利亚民众感到愤怒。

sentences.en: They rallied behind Gregory with the Victorian Premier announcing he'd make sure Gregory received compensation even if he had to change the laws to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们支持格雷戈里，维多利亚州州长宣布，即使必须修改法律，他也会确保格雷戈里获得赔偿。

sentences.en: The following year, the law was updated and Gregory received $5,000 compensation paid into a trust that he could access on his 18th birthday.
sentences.zh: 第二年，法律进行了修订，格雷戈里获得了5000美元的赔偿金，存入了一个信托基金，他可以在18岁生日时支取。

sentences.en: The one-year anniversary of the murders passed with no breakthroughs in the case despite a $50,000 reward for information being announced.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案一周年过去了，尽管悬赏5万美元征集线索，但案件仍无突破。

sentences.en: The public and investigators alike found it difficult to believe that the perpetrator continued to go undetected.
sentences.zh: 公众和调查人员都难以相信肇事者至今未被发现。

sentences.en: Surely there must have been something in their behaviour after the crime that tipped somebody off.
sentences.zh: 肯定有什么人在案发后的行为引起了别人的怀疑。

sentences.en: Perhaps this person had been a heavy drinker who avoided alcohol abruptly following the crime.
sentences.zh: 也许这个人以前是个酗酒者，但在犯罪后突然戒酒了。

sentences.en: Maybe their mental health had taken a sudden downhill turn.
sentences.zh: 也许他们的心理健康状况突然恶化了。

sentences.en: It was also hard to believe that someone would commit a crime so brutal and then never re-offend.
sentences.zh: 也很难相信有人会犯下如此残忍的罪行，却从此不再重犯。

sentences.en: Suzanne's sister, Gail, told the media,
sentences.zh: 苏珊的姐姐盖尔告诉媒体：

sentences.en: We'll never really get over this until the fellow is caught.
sentences.zh: “在凶手被抓住之前，我们永远无法真正走出来。”

sentences.en: You walk around not knowing who did the murder.
sentences.zh: “你走在路上，却不知道是谁犯下了谋杀案。”

sentences.en: It could be the bloke next door.
sentences.zh: “那个人可能是隔壁的邻居。”

sentences.en: One week later, the Armstrong family were again devastated when Suzanne's father died from severe burns he had recently sustained from battling a bushfire.
sentences.zh: 一周后，阿姆斯特朗家族再次遭受重创，苏珊的父亲因在扑灭丛林大火时严重烧伤而不治身亡。

sentences.en: His was yet another life tragically lost within the Armstrong and Bartlett families in the aftermath of Suzanne's and Sue's murders.
sentences.zh: 在苏珊和苏被谋杀后，阿姆斯特朗和巴特莱特家族又失去了一条宝贵的生命。

sentences.en: Sue's father had a fatal heart attack upon learning that his daughter had been killed.
sentences.zh: 苏的父亲在得知女儿被杀后心脏病发作去世。

sentences.en: The next day, one of Sue's aunts also had a heart attack and passed away.
sentences.zh: 第二天，苏的一位姨妈也因心脏病发作去世。

sentences.en: Investigators kept an eye out for similar crimes that could potentially be linked, but Easy Street remained in a league of its own.
sentences.zh: 调查人员留意着可能与之相关的类似犯罪，但易街案件依然是独一无二的。

sentences.en: Some thought the killer might have already passed away, perhaps by suicide, or had been jailed for an unrelated offence.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为凶手可能已经去世，也许是自杀，或者因其他不相关的罪行被监禁。

sentences.en: With no new information and other cases demanding attention, the case went cold.
sentences.zh: 由于没有新信息，且其他案件需要关注，该案陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Cursed by its reputation as the murder house, number 147 Easy Street remained empty for six years, as still and silent as the investigation itself.
sentences.zh: 易街147号被“谋杀屋”的恶名所诅咒，空置了六年，像调查本身一样死寂。

sentences.en: The house eventually sold at a discounted price and the new owner renovated it extensively, tearing out the old wooden floorboards.
sentences.zh: 这所房子最终以折扣价售出，新主人进行了大规模翻修，拆除了旧的木地板。

sentences.en: Decades after the double homicide, the case was reopened.
sentences.zh: 双重谋杀案发生几十年后，案件重新开启。

sentences.en: The new detectives casting their eyes on it for the first time were expecting to have boxes of information to sift through.
sentences.zh: 第一次审视此案的新侦探们本以为会有成箱的信息需要梳理。

sentences.en: However, when they asked for the documents, all they were given was a skinny manila folder containing a few flimsy statements.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他们索要文件时，只得到了一个薄薄的马尼拉文件夹，里面装着几份单薄的陈述。

sentences.en: By the late 90s, forensic technology had improved dramatically and cold cases were starting to be solved using DNA.
sentences.zh: 到了90年代末，法医技术有了显著提高，冷案开始通过DNA技术得到解决。

sentences.en: Victoria Police were hopeful these advances would reveal the identity of the Easy Street killer once and for all.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州警方希望这些进展能最终揭开易街杀手的身份。

sentences.en: There were still eight key suspects on their list, including Barry Woodard and John Grant, and each one of them agreed to provide a blood sample.
sentences.zh: 他们的名单上仍有八名关键嫌疑人，包括巴里·伍达德和约翰·格兰特，他们每一个人都同意提供血样。

sentences.en: DNA from their blood was tested against the semen of the killer.
sentences.zh: 他们血液中的DNA被用来与杀手的精液进行比对。

sentences.en: None were a match.
sentences.zh: 没有匹配结果。

sentences.en: This outcome was a major blow.
sentences.zh: 这一结果是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: For years, investigators and the Armstrong and Bartlett families had held out hope that DNA would be the clue that finally held the answers.
sentences.zh: 多年来，调查人员以及阿姆斯特朗和巴特利特两家人一直怀揣着希望，认为DNA会成为最终揭开谜底的线索。

sentences.en: New leads had long since dried up and now that the physical evidence eliminated the major persons of interest, it seemed increasingly unlikely that the case would ever be solved.
sentences.zh: 新的线索早已断绝，而现在物证又排除了主要嫌疑人，这起案件似乎越来越不可能被侦破了。

sentences.en: Then, in September 1999, a postcard arrived at various media outlets across the city.
sentences.zh: 随后，在1999年9月，全市各家媒体机构都收到了一张明信片。

sentences.en: Postmarked from the town of Bright in northeast Victoria, the writer of the postcards claimed to know who was responsible for the murders.
sentences.zh: 明信片是从维多利亚州东北部布莱特镇寄出的，寄信人声称知道是谁犯下了这些谋杀案。

sentences.en: The cards were forwarded to the homicide squad, who wrote them off as a hoax.
sentences.zh: 这些卡片被转交给了凶杀组，但他们将其视为恶作剧。

sentences.en: Then, in early 2004, a series of letters arrived at the home of Suzanne Armstrong's mother and stepfather.
sentences.zh: 接着，在2004年初，苏珊·阿姆斯特朗的母亲和继父家中收到了一系列信件。

sentences.en: Written in scrawling cursive, they were from the same person who'd authored the postcards four and a half years earlier.
sentences.zh: 这些信件字迹潦草，出自四年前写下那些明信片的同一个人之手。

sentences.en: His name was Peter Collier, and he openly criticised the police for not taking his previous claims seriously.
sentences.zh: 他叫彼得·科利尔，他公开批评警方没有认真对待他之前的说法。

sentences.en: As reported in the book
sentences.zh: 正如书中所述

sentences.en: Murder on Easy Street,
sentences.zh: 《易街谋杀案》，

sentences.en: Peter had been a patient at Melbourne's
sentences.zh: 彼得曾是墨尔本

sentences.en: La Rundle Psychiatric Hospital in early 1977.
sentences.zh: 拉伦德精神病院1977年初的一名病人。

sentences.en: In late January, his friend,
sentences.zh: 一月下旬，他的朋友，

sentences.en: 30-year-old Anthony Thomas Christie, was also admitted after attempting to end his own life.
sentences.zh: 30岁的安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂，在试图自杀后也被送进了医院。
zh_words: 安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂

sentences.en: Christy spent 10 days in a coma before regaining consciousness.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂昏迷了10天后才恢复意识。

sentences.en: Three weeks later,
sentences.zh: 三周后，

sentences.en: Peter was sitting in a group therapy session with seven other patients, including Christy, when Christy made a startling revelation.
sentences.zh: 彼得正在参加一个有包括克里斯蒂在内的七名患者参与的团体治疗会议，这时克里斯蒂说出了一个惊人的秘密。

sentences.en: After having sex with women, he felt an overwhelming desire to kill them with a carving knife.
sentences.zh: 他说在与女性发生性关系后，他会产生一种强烈的杀人冲动，想用雕刻刀杀掉她们。

sentences.en: Peter was stunned.
sentences.zh: 彼得惊呆了。

sentences.en: He started to put two and two together.
sentences.zh: 他开始把这些线索串联起来。

sentences.en: He knew Christy had a criminal past, and the timing of the suicide attempt had him questioning whether Christy could have committed the Easy Street murders
sentences.zh: 他知道克里斯蒂有犯罪前科，而他自杀的时间点让他怀疑克里斯蒂是否就是易街谋杀案的凶手，

sentences.en: and then tried to take his own life because of it.
sentences.zh: 并因此试图结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: In one of the letters to Suzanne's family,
sentences.zh: 在写给苏珊家人的其中一封信中，

sentences.en: Peter wrote,
sentences.zh: 彼得写道：

sentences.en: A far more likely scenario is that Suzanne and Christy were involved in pillow talk.
sentences.zh: “更有可能的情况是，苏珊和克里斯蒂之间有过私密谈话。”

sentences.en: He's told Suzanne that he's killed a couple of crimps.
sentences.zh: “他告诉苏珊他杀过几个罪犯。”

sentences.en: He'd hinted that to me.
sentences.zh: “他曾向我暗示过这一点。”

sentences.en: The women have decided to get rid of Christy and they have threatened him with the police.
sentences.zh: “这些女人决定除掉克里斯蒂，并用警察威胁他。”

sentences.en: He's lost control.
sentences.zh: “他失去了理智。”

sentences.en: They're dead.
sentences.zh: “她们死了。”

sentences.en: What would have made him lose control?
sentences.zh: 是什么让他失去了理智？

sentences.en: His hatred for the police.
sentences.zh: 他对警察的仇恨。

sentences.en: Peter explained that he didn't speak up at the time because he was suffering from poor mental health himself.
sentences.zh: 彼得解释说，他当时没有说出来，是因为他自己的心理健康状况也很糟糕。

sentences.en: He couldn't believe that the staff at La Rundle had failed to pass the information on to the relevant authorities.
sentences.zh: 他无法相信拉伦德医院的工作人员竟然没有将这些信息转达给相关部门。

sentences.en: It haunted him to this day, bolstered by the fact that Christy had since passed away without facing any consequences.
sentences.zh: 这件事至今仍困扰着他，而克里斯蒂在没有承担任何后果的情况下就已经去世，这让他更加耿耿于怀。

sentences.en: In another letter,
sentences.zh: 在另一封信中，

sentences.en: Peter wrote,
sentences.zh: 彼得写道：

sentences.en: There is one way to get the truth out and that is to put it out on the internet that Anthony Thomas Christy is the Easy Street killer.
sentences.zh: “有一个办法可以查明真相，那就是在互联网上公开安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂就是易街杀手。”
zh_words: 安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂

sentences.en: That would put some pressure on the creeps covering up the truth.
sentences.zh: “那会对那些掩盖真相的混蛋施加一些压力。”

sentences.en: Suzanne's family reported the information to police who dismissed
sentences.zh: 苏珊的家人向警方报告了这一信息，但警方驳回了

sentences.en: Peter Collier's theory.
sentences.zh: 彼得·科利尔的理论。

sentences.en: Apparently, this wasn't the first time he'd made these kinds of claims to bereaved family members.
sentences.zh: 显然，这已经不是他第一次向受害者家属提出这类说法了。

sentences.en: It wouldn't be the last time either.
sentences.zh: 这也不会是最后一次。

sentences.en: In November 2005,
Easy Street was abuzz when several residents found a letter in their mailboxes from Peter.
sentences.zh: 易街的居民们议论纷纷，因为几位住户在信箱里发现了彼得寄来的信。

sentences.en: Written in black text in all capitals, it read,
sentences.zh: 信中用黑色大写字母写道：

sentences.en: La Rundle Hospital protected
sentences.zh: “拉伦德医院多年来一直包庇

sentences.en: Anthony Thomas Christy for the Easy Street murders for years.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂，掩盖易街谋杀案。”
zh_words: 安东尼·托马斯·克里斯蒂

sentences.en: While it was clear that Peter had an ongoing fixation with the case, there was no evidence to back his claiMs.
sentences.zh: 虽然很明显彼得对这起案件有着持续的执念，但没有任何证据支持他的说法。

sentences.en: Although, if the killer was being held in a mental health facility, that would explain why no similar crimes were committed after Suzanne Armstrong and Sue Bartlett's murders.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果凶手一直被关在精神卫生机构，那就能解释为什么在苏珊·阿姆斯特朗和苏·巴特利特被谋杀后，再没有发生过类似的犯罪。

sentences.en: That's one element that continues to baffle investigators.
sentences.zh: 这是让调查人员至今感到困惑的一个因素。

sentences.en: It just didn't seem plausible that someone could commit such an extreme, brutal murder, then go on to live a normal life without ever killing again.
sentences.zh: 一个人犯下如此极端、残忍的谋杀案，然后继续过正常生活而再未杀人，这似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: By January 2017,
sentences.zh: 到了2017年1月，

sentences.en: four decades had passed and police were still no closer to making an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 四十年过去了，警方在逮捕凶手方面仍毫无进展。

sentences.en: If anyone other than the killer knew who was responsible, they had either taken their secret to the grave or continued to live with the knowledge.
sentences.zh: 如果除了凶手之外还有人知道真相，他们要么已经把秘密带进了坟墓，要么就是带着这个秘密继续生活。

sentences.en: In the hopes of enticing someone to talk,
sentences.zh: 为了诱使知情者开口，

sentences.en: Victoria Police announced a $1 million reward for information as well as possible indemnity against prosecution for anyone who came forward.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州警方宣布悬赏100万澳元征集线索，并承诺为提供线索者提供可能的起诉豁免权。
